en: “A magazine?”
As I'm sweeping, I come across a fashion magazine on the floor.
I open it up and skim through the pages. It's filled with tons of hot models.
“Geez... These babes are total... babes.”
“They're still not as hot as these three sisters.”
“Hold on...”
“Eh? N-no way?”
“NO WAY!!!”
“Kasumi!!!”
“Ah! What?!”
After we finish eating, I take out the magazine that I found during the day.
“That's the first time I've ever seen Kasumi scared.”
“I wasn't ready for that, that's all~”
“What?”
“Are you going to tell her you love her?”
“Huh? Wait, what?”
“Whatever! What I wanted to say was—”
I turn to the page that I had stumbled upon when I was cleaning.
“Kasumi's a model?!”
“And then it says that she's not just a model, there's all this stuff about how she's—”
“You didn't know?”
“Kasumi used to be super famous.”
“She acted in movies, put out some singles, and several magazines featured her for photo shoots and stuff.”
“Ha... That was a long time ago.”
“Oh... So that's what you were talking about before?”
“So... you don't do that anymore? Like, not at all?”
“Um... Yeah. That's finished.”
“Because of that piece of shit.”
“Forcing her to step away from the limelight.”
“It's fine. That's in the past.”
“Plus...”
“You never think about going back?”
“I have.”
“That's great!”
“I'll be able to brag to my friends again!”
“But I haven't had much luck recently...”
“Not to mention I'm getting old. I'm not sure it would work.”
“Pshhh. No way. You couldn't hide your talent if you tried. Don't you think?”
“I... Well, I didn't know Kasumi back then.”
“But that girl I see in the magazine doesn't compare to the Kasumi I know.”
“Sounds like a forced answer to me. Ha.”
“Nuh-uh! I'm just stunned, that's all.”
“I think you should just do what you want to do, that's all.”
“Really?”
“Alright, I'll think about it.”
